status: Reference implementation completed and native/Release verified. The ten-second activation is supported by another emulator implementation, not an original Blizzard combat log. Retail timing and client confirmation remain pending.
implementation: Mythic Grimelord schedules one triggered self-cast of permanent Fetid Fission ten seconds after EnterCombat. It does not schedule a repeating escalation. Reset removes this permanent modifier before the same actor can start another fight.

The original Grimelord's modifier changes new Fetid Rot applications from three stacks to four on Mythic only. Initial infection and secondary spread share this admission. Activation does not immediately alter an existing carrier aura. Retain native per-stack damage/healing, periodic decay/spread, original caster GUID and the existing reinfection increment/native nine-stack cap; no new SQL binding is required.

Retain the independently researched seven-second first Rot, difficulty-specific repeat timers, Slam/Nova timing, native selection and geometry. Those timers are not copied from the newly found emulator, whose other timings differ.
